mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/cache-eviction.md <<'EOF'
# Cache Eviction Policy

The project's current recorded decision is to use LRU (Least Recently Used) eviction for the cache layer, with a fixed time-to-live (TTL) of 300 seconds. LRU was chosen because it is simpler to reason about and gives a deterministic eviction order based on access recency, which makes cache behavior easier to understand and debug.
EOF
cat docs/policies/cache-eviction.md
